falsifiability.mutation_set_completeness: Eight guards this card delivers were neutralised one at a time: the live-run handoff gate, the stale-epoch check, the writer-attribution check, the request-hash comparison, the watermark-ahead refusal, the truncation report, the sealed-session gate and the attach grant check. Seven are caught by a named card row. M1 (the live-run gate) is reported as CRASHED, not survived or caught: the replacement text left the package uncompilable, so it credits no row and the gate it replaces is therefore still unmeasured by mutation (the id that covers it, W06-02-TAKEOVER-REFUSED-WHILE-RUN-LIVE, is only shown green, not shown killable). What this matrix does NOT cover, named rather than left implied: the grant checks on ConfirmRunStop, OpenClientSession, WriteAsWriter, SessionEvents and ListClientSessions (only the attach and read paths were mutated); the limit-above-200 refusals on the two read paths; the cross-project NOT_FOUND branch; and the runState 404 branch for a session whose run row has disappeared. Each would need its own neutralisation plus a refusal id, and none is claimed here as covered.

mid_card_failure_disclosed.what: the first mutation matrix run reported all eight mutations as crashed-mutant-ill-formed
mid_card_failure_disclosed.fix: the runner had passed a relative GOPATH, so every go test invocation exited 2 before emitting a row; the runner now reads the absolute GOPATH/GOCACHE from the registry entry that runs this package, and it aborts if the baseline itself produces no rows
mid_card_failure_disclosed.retry_count: 0 - the input changed with the runner fix; the invalid face is not kept because the file had not been registered or hashed by any reviewer when it was replaced

mid_card_failure_disclosed.what: the test deadlocked and hit the 8m go test timeout after the sealed-session id was added
mid_card_failure_disclosed.fix: a write transaction was held open across service calls that open their own; the seal now runs in a transaction closed before the next call (session_w0602_test.go)

mid_card_failure_disclosed.what: W06-02-DUPLICATE-COMMAND-CHARGES-ONCE went red on the first green-looking build
mid_card_failure_disclosed.fix: a real defect in the delivered code: the idempotency row was stored keyed by the digest of the reply while the replay compares the request digest, so every replay looked like IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED
mid_card_failure_disclosed.retry_count: 0 - fixed in the product, not in the assertion

mid_card_failure_disclosed.what: the first race assertion demanded exactly one successful takeover
mid_card_failure_disclosed.fix: the store serialises the two claims, so both can land and the epoch advances twice; the assertion was rewritten to the invariant that actually matters (no lost update, and the client that did not end as writer is refused on both epochs it could have held) rather than being loosened until it passed

mid_card_failure_disclosed.what: W06-02-SESSION-OPENED-WITH-EPOCH-ONE first failed with no such table client_sessions, and the fixture project has no domain_objects Project row either
